playlist_format: Strict M3U: #EXTM3U header; each #EXTINF record is immediately followed by its HTTP(S) stream URL; source verification details are retained in this JSON report.

source_notes.IPTV-org: Complete HTTP/HTTPS source catalogue retained except NSFW/blocked/denied-host entries; broadcaster-domain matches are labelled.
source_notes.IPTV Cat: Exported HTTP/HTTPS rows retained except NSFW/blocked/denied-host entries; online/offline/unknown status and domain-match labels are included.
source_notes.Doubo Public Directory: Separate directory advertised as broadcaster-provided free public streams; availability and regional restrictions can change.
source_notes.WizakorHD Curated Public TV: Community-curated list described by its maintainer as original URLs from free services; personal-use terms and attribution apply.
source_notes.Tubi/Roku/Plex/Pluto/Samsung FAST: Community-generated service catalogues; stream availability and territorial restrictions vary. Use remains subject to the respective service terms.
source_notes.Apsattv FAST catalogues: Community-maintained free-service M3U lists; its catalogue notes that some feeds may be stale or geo-restricted.
source_notes.Free-TV/IPTV: Curated free-TV source; subject to broadcaster and geographic restrictions.
source_notes.LegalFreeIPTV: Curated legal-free feed with published acceptance criteria.
